saw_lines: People buy an advent calendar for the surprise inside and the gift value, and they decide in the weeks before December.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the value and surprise must show before the click.
Your 2 ads carry no proof number, so buyers have no trust signal before the click. Add one review count or orders shipped to the next creative and lead with it.
ads_1: Keep one ad, build three variations on the 230€ value and 24 surprises
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, X, Youtube
